### Silencing Lies - Today's Insight - May 7, 2024
Author: Charles R. Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/todays-insight-may-7-2024.html
Passage: Job 20:4-5
Points:
- Harsh and cutting words are frequently cloaked in pious, eloquent language.
- Practicing self-control means carefully weighing our words, tone, and truthfulness before speaking.
- Zophar disregarded restraint and wounded Job by launching reckless, false accusations.
- Interrogating rumors at their source helps halt gossip and lets the truth prevail.
- While quietly enduring attacks can be appropriate at times, believers must sometimes speak up to set the record straight against destructive slander.
